title: Vision 2030
subtitle: The national blueprint behind Saudi Arabia's digital transformation.
intro: Saudi Vision 2030 is the Kingdom's long-term roadmap, launched in 2016. It sets out how the country diversifies its economy, empowers its people, and builds a government that works effectively. Digital transformation is one of the main ways this vision reaches people's daily lives.

items.title: A Vibrant Society
items.text: A society where people can pursue their passions and enjoy a fulfilling life. It is the foundation on which the economy and the nation are built.

items.title: A Thriving Economy
items.text: An economy that is diversifying and offers everyone the opportunity to succeed.

items.title: An Ambitious Nation
items.text: A nation committed to efficiency and accountability, with a government that is effective, transparent, and high-performing.

items.caption: Riyadh at night, with Kingdom Centre lit up

items.title: A Dedicated National Strategy
items.text: The Digital Government Strategy 2023-2030 defines the Kingdom's ambitions, objectives, and roadmap for digital government, and is aligned with the goals of Vision 2030.
